description: Fix broken photo previews in PhotoUpload.vue. Currently prepends '/storage/' to photo.file_path which is already a full Supabase signed URL, breaking the image src. Change line 109 to use photo.file_path directly without the prefix. This is a critical bug affecting all photo displays.
steps: Read c:\Users\Juan Miguel\Cronevia\frontend\src\components\ui\PhotoUpload.vue lines 100-120 to locate the broken img src attribute
Change line 109 from `:src="\`/storage/${photo.file_path}\`"` to `:src="photo.file_path"` — the file_path already contains the full signed HTTPS URL from Supabase createSignedUrl
Verify no other locations in PhotoUpload.vue incorrectly prefix the signed URL
acceptance_criteria: Line 109 reads :src="photo.file_path" without any path prefix
Photo previews display correctly when viewing an existing journal entry with uploaded photos
verification: Run `npm run build` from frontend/ — TypeScript compilation succeeds
Start `npm run dev` and navigate to /journal/:id for an entry with photos; photos should display instead of showing broken image placeholders
